caveat: distinct means not permutation-equivalent to any seeded or literature entry on this board, not that the code is unpublished; review is a flag, not a verdict; nothing here is a novelty claim
head: d5a2a7406f92841ae1129c7db228c4d6eac35892
method: each CSS entry against the reference set by exact fingerprint (verify/qldpc_verify.py css_fingerprint: rref of H_X and H_Z) and Weisfeiler-Leman signature of the typed Tanner graph (signature); WL pairs the permutation audit decided carry its verdict

reference.definition: provenance.origin baseline, or bucket literature in derived.json

rule.distinct: the Weisfeiler-Leman signature matches no reference entry: not permutation-equivalent to any seeded or literature entry on the board; says nothing about codes the board does not carry
rule.exact_match: the fingerprint (rref of H_X and H_Z) equals a reference entry's: the same stabilizer group on the same qubit labels
rule.review: the Weisfeiler-Leman signature equals a reference entry's and the fingerprint does not: possibly permutation-equivalent; a review item, carrying the permutation audit's verdict where it has one
